## Details

<a id="high_score_1p"></a>
### [`high_score_1p`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables_1299.asm#L6) `$1299-$129E`

*variable*

High score of the one-player game: six characters, leading spaces. high_score_update ($200a) writes it, high_score_show ($2115) shows it.

- **Read by:** [`high_score_show`](timer_and_texts.md#high_score_show)
- **Referred to by:** [`high_score_update`](score_and_judge.md#high_score_update)

<a id="high_score_2p"></a>
### [`high_score_2p`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables_1299.asm#L9) `$129F-$12A4`

*variable*

High score of the two-player game: six characters, leading spaces. high_score_update ($2023) writes it.

- **Read by:** [`high_score_show`](timer_and_texts.md#high_score_show)
- **Referred to by:** [`high_score_update`](score_and_judge.md#high_score_update)

<a id="move_score_values"></a>
### [`move_score_values`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables_1299.asm#L12) `$12A5-$12BD`

*data*

Move table: points of a full-point hit in hundreds. A half point gives half.

- **Read by:** [`score_add_move`](score_and_judge.md#score_add_move), [`bout_hit_value_add`](timer_and_texts.md#bout_hit_value_add)

<a id="text_1_player"></a>
### [`text_1_player`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables_1299.asm#L18) `$12BE-$12C5`

*data*

<a id="yin_yang_fighter_offsets"></a>
### [`yin_yang_fighter_offsets`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables_1299.asm#L23) `$12CE-$12CF`

*data*

Screen offset of the yin-yang symbols of fighter 0 and fighter 1.

- **Read by:** [`hit_test`](../fighter/hit_test.md#hit_test)

<a id="ai_move_substitute"></a>
### [`ai_move_substitute`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables_1299.asm#L26) `$12D0-$12E8`

*data*

AI attack substitution by move $00-$18, read at $26b4 when the opponent is in move $04, $07, $0a or $10. High attacks become low ones: $06, $0d and $18 become $0b; $07, $0c, $0e and $11 become $0a; $0f becomes $10.

- **Read by:** [`ai_substitute_move`](../ai/ai_opponent_2521.md#ai_substitute_move)

<a id="fighter_x_min"></a>
### [`fighter_x_min`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables_1299.asm#L32) `$12E9-$12EA`

*data*

Smallest fighter_x by fighter_facing: $0c for facing 0, $00 for facing 1. Read by anim_step at $3858.

- **Read by:** [`anim_step`](../fighter/anim_step.md#anim_step)

<a id="fighter_x_max"></a>
### [`fighter_x_max`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables_1299.asm#L35) `$12EB-$12EC`

*data*

Largest fighter_x by fighter_facing: $95 for facing 0, $89 for facing 1. Read by anim_step at $3862. v1 used fixed limits.

- **Read by:** [`anim_step`](../fighter/anim_step.md#anim_step)
